Privacy Policy

What this website collects, why, and what we do with it. Written to be read, not to be scrolled past.

Last updated 13 September 2026

The short version

This website sets no cookies, runs no analytics, and contains no advertising or tracking pixels. The only personal information it handles is what you choose to type into the enquiry form. We use that to answer your enquiry. We do not sell it and we do not share it for marketing.

Who we are

Swasim Granite, quarry owners, processors and exporters of Indian granite, based at Shoolgiri / Sappadi, Hosur, Tamil Nadu, India. For anything in this policy — including a request to see, correct or delete your information — contact us at swasimgranite@gmail.com or +91 94488 41482.

What we collect

Only what you enter in the enquiry form on our contact page:

  • your name
  • your company (optional)
  • your email address
  • your destination port (optional)
  • the stone and finish you are interested in
  • the requirement you describe

There are no other forms on this site, and no hidden fields that collect anything else. Separately, and like every website, our hosting provider keeps standard server logs (IP address, time of request, page requested) for security and diagnostics.

How it reaches us

The enquiry form sends nothing from this website. When you press Send B2B Inquiry, it opens WhatsApp with your enquiry typed out, and it reaches us only if you send that message from your own WhatsApp account — which, as with any WhatsApp message, also shows us your number and profile name. The Call, WhatsApp and email links on the site likewise open your own phone, WhatsApp or email application. This website does not see or record anything you send those ways, and your use of WhatsApp is governed by WhatsApp's own privacy terms, not ours.

Cookies and tracking

This site sets no cookies of any kind, and there is nothing to consent to. We do not use Google Analytics or any equivalent, we do not embed advertising or social tracking scripts, and no third party receives information about your visit.

What is stored on your device

To work smoothly on slow or intermittent connections, this site stores a copy of its own pages, images and fonts in your browser's cache. That copy stays on your device, is never sent anywhere, identifies nobody, and disappears when you clear your browser's site data. It is a speed measure, not a tracking one.

Why we use your information, and for how long

We use your enquiry to reply to you, prepare a quotation, and — if you go ahead — to fulfil and ship your order. We keep it for as long as we are doing business with you, and afterwards for the period we are required to retain commercial and tax records under Indian law. Enquiries that do not lead to business are deleted once they are clearly no longer live.

Who else sees it

Our hosting and email providers process it on our behalf in order to deliver the site and our mail. Nobody else. We do not sell, rent or trade your information, and we do not pass it to third parties for their own marketing.

Your rights

You can ask us what information we hold about you, ask us to correct it, or ask us to delete it. Email swasimgranite@gmail.com and we will respond. If you are in the European Economic Area or the United Kingdom, the GDPR gives you these rights and the right to complain to your national data protection authority; if you are in India, the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 applies.

Changes

If this policy changes, the revised version will appear on this page with a new date at the top.
